name: LCU Computer Use
description: Connect Minih sessions to a locally installed LCU runtime through its Pi adapter.
author: minih-git

en.name: LCU Computer Use
en.description: Use the locally installed LCU runtime for desktop automation in Minih sessions.
en.safetyNotes: Apple Silicon macOS only. Runs trusted code inside the agent and starts the local LCU process. Requires the official ChatGPT app and OS permissions; this plugin installs neither dependency. Desktop screenshots can reach the selected model. Original app/site approval remains required: Always allow invokes LCU owner authentication and saves a shared app grant; session approval stays temporary. Revoke access with lcu apps revoke. Marketplace packages use SHA-256 integrity checks, not a publisher signature.

zh-CN.name: LCU 桌面控制
zh-CN.description: 在 Minih 会话中通过本机已安装的 LCU 运行时操作桌面。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 仅支持 Apple Silicon macOS。在 Agent 进程内运行受信代码并启动本机 LCU，需要自行安装官方 ChatGPT 应用和 LCU，并授予系统权限。桌面截图可能发送给所选模型。保留应用及站点授权：Always allow 会调用 LCU 的本人认证并保存共享应用授权；本会话允许仅临时生效。可通过 lcu apps revoke 撤销。市场包有 SHA-256 完整性校验，尚无发布者数字签名。
